title: Point containment does not establish quotient-ring identity
situation: V(x^2) and V(x) have the same field-valued points; x is not zero modulo (x^2).
attempted_conclusion: Pull x=0 back from the reduced model to Q[x]/(x^2) using radical containment.

expected.reason: Point-level containment does not supply the needed ideal-level pullback.

sources.anchor: "Establish it another way and record how -- a radical-membership "
